# Open choices: mobile-apps

`aidd-team:mobile-apps` leaves these decisions to the team. aidd's default holds until a `standards` entry fills one. `aidd standard list` names the library standards for each choice, and `aidd standard add` adopts one.

| Choice | Question | aidd's default | Options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mobile-framework` | Which framework builds the iOS and Android apps? | The framework the app already uses. For a new cross-platform app, Expo (React Native) when the team writes TypeScript, and Flutter when it writes Dart. | Expo (React Native), Flutter, Swift and Kotlin, one app per platform, React Native without Expo |
| `mobile-ui-test` | Which runner drives the app's UI tests on a device or an emulator? | Maestro for an Expo app, `integration_test` for a Flutter app, XCUITest and Espresso for a native app, and Detox for React Native without Expo. | Maestro, integration_test, Detox, XCUITest, Espresso |
